```{r}
#| code-summary: "Setup"
#| code-fold: true


library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(assertr)

source("0-context.R")
```



Here we compile and inventory the final data structures from the requested components. This is an early draft pending calcification on harmonization scheme (what levels and variables across countries).

But we will have two datasets:

1. Daily datasets (city + sub-city data merged)
2. Neighborhood level exposure data

You can access all these data here.

```{{r}}
df_subcity_daily =  "`r context$df_subcity_daily`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_subcity_daily_age =  "`r context$df_subcity_daily_age`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_pct_green =  "`r context$df_pct_green`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_pct_primary =  "`r context$df_pct_primary`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_nbhd_pop_dens =  "`r context$df_nbhd_pop_dens`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
```

Below we harmnoize across the geographic levels to make sure everything can be linked for analysis. 

# Daily dataset


This will include sub-city death counts with city level daily temperature merged in. Note that we have two death counts datasets (total and by age group).


## Counts

```{r}

## Components
df_city_temp = context$df_city_temp %>% 
  open_dataset() %>% 
  select(city_geoid, date, temperature) %>% 
  collect()
df_mort = context$df_mort %>% read_parquet()


## Merge
df_subcity_daily = df_mort %>% left_join(df_city_temp)
df_subcity_daily %>%  arrow::write_parquet(context$df_subcity_daily)

## Preview
df_subcity_daily %>% glimpse()
```

Looks good 

## Counts by Age 

```{r}

## Components
df_mort_age = context$df_mort_age %>% read_parquet()


## Merge
df_subcity_daily_age = df_mort_age %>% 
  left_join(df_city_temp)

## Preview
df_subcity_daily_age %>% glimpse()
```

# Cross sectional datasets

We have neighrbohood data at a few levels; Derekw ill figure out how to use them and the appropriate data structures.

## Components

### Greeness

```{r}
df_pct_green = context$df_pct_green %>%
  read_parquet() 
glimpse(df_pct_green)
```



### Education

```{r}
df_pct_primary = context$df_pct_primary %>% 
  read_parquet() 
glimpse(df_pct_primary)
```


### Pop. Density

```{r}
df_nbhd_pop_dens = context$df_nbhd_pop_dens %>% 
  read_parquet() 
glimpse(df_nbhd_pop_dens)
```
 
## Summary

```{r}
list(
  df_pct_green %>% count(iso2, geo) %>% mutate(var = 'pct_green'),
  df_pct_primary %>% count(iso2, geo) %>% mutate(var = 'pct_primary'),
  df_nbhd_pop_dens %>% count(iso2, geo) %>% mutate(var = 'pop_dens')
) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>% 
  select(-n) %>% 
  select(var, iso2, geo) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = iso2, values_from = geo)
```
